title: P2: handoff.py no replay_bitfield size validation
description:
File: python/src/lichen/gateway/handoff.py
Line: 188

In OscoreState.from_cbor_map(), replay_bitfield is extracted from CBOR with no size validation:

    replay_bitfield=replay[1],

Python integers are arbitrary precision. An attacker-crafted CBOR payload could set replay_bitfield to an astronomically large value (e.g., 2^1000000), causing memory exhaustion when stored and processed.

OSCORE replay windows are typically 32 or 64 bits. The code should validate:
    if not 0 <= replay_bitfield < 2**64:
        raise HandoffError('replay_bitfield out of range')

Fix: Add bounds check for replay_bitfield and replay_index in from_cbor_map(). Consider also validating window_size has a reasonable maximum.

Impact: Memory DoS via malformed handoff response.
